      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">
        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin-right: 3.5pt; margin-left: 0.65pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Impairment of long-lived assets&#160;<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">related to Property, Plant &amp; Equipment of the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit</span></div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-style: italic;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Description of the matter</span></div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
        </div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">At December 31, 2024, the Company&#8217;s net book value of Property, Plant &amp;
          Equipment (&#8220;PPE&#8221;) related to the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit was Argentine Pesos 1,275,875 million. As discussed in Notes 4 (j) and 5 (a) to the consolidated financial statements, PPE is tested to assess whether an impairment
          or reversal of a previous impairment is required when significant changes that took place during the period, or will take place in the near future, indicate that the recoverable value of the PPE amounts may be affected. An asset&#8217;s recoverable
          amount is the higher of the fair value less costs to sell that asset, and its value-in-use. The value in use is calculated based on discounted future cash flows. Management&#8217;s projected cash flows for the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating
          unit considered significant judgements and assumptions relating to: discount rate, estimates of future tariffs and the recognition of cost adjustments, and expected macroeconomic variables such as inflation and foreign exchange rates. During the
          year ended December 31, 2024, the Company recorded a gain of Argentine Pesos 39,625 million due to the reversal of previous impairment charged to PPE related to the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit.</div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
        </div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">The principal considerations for our determination that performing procedures
          relating to the impairment of long-lived assets for PPE of the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit is a critical audit matter are the significant judgment by management in estimating the value in use of this cash-generating unit, a
          high degree of auditor judgment, subjectivity and effort in performing procedures and evaluating management&#8217;s significant assumptions related to discount rate, estimates of future tariffs and the recognition of cost adjustments and expected
          macroeconomic variables such as inflation and foreign exchange rates. In addition, the audit effort involved professionals with specialized skill and knowledge.</div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
        </div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin-left: 0.65pt; font-style: italic;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">How we addressed the matter in our audit</span></div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
        </div>

        <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin-left: 0.65pt;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Addressing the matter
            involved performing procedures and evaluating audit evidence in connection with forming our overall opinion on the consolidated financial statements. These audit procedures included obtaining an understanding, evaluating the design and testing
            the operating effectiveness of controls over management&#8217;s impairment review process, including controls over the review of the significant assumptions.&#160;</span>These procedures also&#160;<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">included, among others,
            evaluating the estimation methodology and testing the aforementioned significant assumptions and the completeness, accuracy, and relevance of underlying data used. The significant assumptions were compared with available economic trend data;
            the historical accuracy of management&#8217;s estimates was evaluated; sensitivity analyses of the significant assumptions were performed to evaluate the changes in the value in use that would result from changes in the assumptions; the arithmetical
            accuracy of the discounted cash flows model was evaluated; and the disclosures in the consolidated financial statements were assessed. Professionals with specialized skill and knowledge were involved to assist in the evaluation of the
            methodology and the significant assumptions used in the future cash flows estimated by management.</span></div>

      </div>

      <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;"><!--Anchor-->REPORT OF INDEPENDENT REGISTERED PUBLIC ACCOUNTING FIRMS</div>

      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">To the Board of Directors and Shareholders of</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Opinion on Internal Control over Financial Reporting</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We have audited Transportadora de Gas del Sur
          S.A. and its subsidiaries (together the &#8220;Company&#8221;)</span>&#160;internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2024, based on criteria established in&#160;<span style="font-style: italic;">Internal Control&#160; Integrated Framework</span><span style="color: rgb(255, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (2013 framework) (&#8220;the COSO criteria&#8221;). In our opinion, the Company maintained, in all material respects, effective internal
        control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2024, based on the COSO criteria.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">We also have audited, in accordance with the standards of the Public Company
        Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (&#8220;PCAOB&#8221;), the consolidated statements of financial position of the Company as of December 31, 2024 and 2023, and the related consolidated statements of comprehensive income, changes in equity and cash
        flows for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2024, and the related notes (collectively referred to as the &#8220;consolidated financial statements&#8221;), and our report dated April 24, 2025 expressed an unqualified opinion thereon.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Basis for Opinion</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">
        <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
          <div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
            <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
              <div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company&#8217;s management is responsible for maintaining effective internal control over financial reporting, and for its assessment of the effectiveness of
                internal control over financial reporting included in the accompanying Management&#8217;s Annual Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting.&#160; Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company&#8217;s internal control over financial
                reporting based on our audit.&#160; We are public accounting firms registered with the PCAOB and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and
                regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.</div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We conducted our</span>&#160;audit i<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">n accordance with the standards of the PCAOB.&#160; Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether effective internal control over financial reporting was maintained
          in all material respects.</span></div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Our audit included obtaining an understanding of internal control over financial
        reporting, assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal control based on the assessed risk, and performing such other procedures as we considered necessary in the
        circumstances. We believe that our audit provides a reasonable basis for our opinion.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">F-3</span></div>

        <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
          <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;"/></div>

          <div>
            <div style="font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: italic;">
              <div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: normal;"><a href="#TABLEOFCONTENTS"><span style="font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic;">Table of Contents</span></a></div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Definition and Limitations of Internal Control over Financial Reporting</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">A company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to
        provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. A company&#8217;s internal control over financial
        reporting includes those policies and procedures that (i) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the assets of the company; (ii) provide reasonable
        assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, and that receipts and expenditures of the company are being made only in accordance
        with authorizations of management and directors of the company; and (iii) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the company&#8217;s assets that could have a material
        effect on the financial statements.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting may
        not prevent or detect misstatements. Also, projections of any evaluation of effectiveness to future periods are subject to the risk that controls may become inadequate because of changes in conditions, or that the degree of compliance with the
        policies or procedures may deteriorate.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Business Overview</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d3" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d4">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d4" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d5">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (&#8220;<span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) is one of the
      companies created as a result of the privatization of Gas del Estado S.E. (&#8220;GdE&#8221;). <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> commenced operations on December 28, 1992 and it is mainly engaged in the
      Transportation of Natural Gas, and Production and Commercialization of natural gas Liquids (&#8220;Liquids&#8221;). TGS&#8217;s pipeline system connects major natural gas fields in southern and western Argentina with natural gas distributors and industries in those
      areas and in the greater Buenos Aires area. The natural gas transportation license to operate this system was exclusively granted to <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> for a period of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfTransportationLicenseGranted" id="Fact_12c9299722f84cfbb830e5af61b67937" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">thirty-five years</ix:nonNumeric> (&#8220;the License&#8221;). <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>is entitled to a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:NumberOfExtensionOnLicenseGranted" id="Fact_f7a220ef8f8d4ce1a59c07f88cabc4ba" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U005" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">one</ix:nonFraction>-time extension of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfExtensionOnLicenseGranted" id="Fact_4c0b27b26342446295011bea35aa0524" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric> provided that it has essentially met the
      obligations imposed by the License and by <span style="font-style: italic;">Ente Nacional Regulador del Gas</span> (National Gas Regulatory Body or &#8220;ENARGAS&#8221;). The General Cerri Gas Processing Complex (the &#8220;Cerri Complex&#8221;), where TGS processes
      natural gas to obtain liquids, was transferred from GdE along with the gas transmission assets. <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> also provides midstream services, which mainly consist of
      gas treatment, removal of impurities from the natural gas stream, gas compression, wellhead gas gathering and pipeline construction, operation and maintenance services. In addition, telecommunications services are provided through the subsidiary
      Telcosur S.A. (&#8220;Telcosur&#8221;). These services consist of data transmission services through a network of terrestrial and digital radio relay.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d5" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d6">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d6" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d7">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Subsequently, the corporate purpose of the Company was modified to incorporate the development of complementary activities, incidental, linked and / or derived from
      natural gas transportation, such as the generation and commercialization of electric power and the provision of other services for the hydrocarbon sector in general.</div>
</ix:continuation>

        </span></div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d10" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d11">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">On November 4, 2024, the Board of Directors of the Company decided to establish the Dedicated Branch Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. &#8211; Sucursal Dedicada 1 (hereinafter &#8220;Dedicated Branch&#8221;), to
          request adherence to the Large Investment Incentive Regime (&#8220;RIGI&#8221;), in relation to the project to expand the transportation capacity of the Perito Francisco Pascasio Moreno Gas Pipeline (&#8220;Perito Moreno Gas Pipeline&#8221;), on the Tratay&#233;n &#8211;
          Salliquel&#243; route.</span></div>

      </span> </div>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d14" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d15">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">The RIGI promotes investment in projects that qualify as large long-term investments in Argentina by granting a series of tax, customs, and exchange incentives, as well as an efficient system for the
        protection of rights and resolution of disputes. Projects that adhere to the RIGI must be developed in specific sectors defined by Law 27,742 and Decree 749/2024, including the activities of Transportation and Storage of oil and gas.</span> </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d15" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d16">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>
    </div>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d16" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d17">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Dedicated Branch will have the sole purpose of executing of a unique project in the oil and gas sector, which involves the transportation capacity of section I of
      the Perito Moreno Gas Pipeline, on the Tratay&#233;n - Saliquell&#243; route and the exploitation of the project, which includes transporting and/or using and/or disposing of the natural gas transportation capacity resulting from the expansion project for
      itself and for third parties through any title, modality or figure permitted by applicable regulations. For such purposes, the Dedicated Branch may carry out all those activities that are accessory, complementary and/or subsidiary to the execution,
      operation and maintenance of said project (including but not limited to the construction, operation and/or maintenance of pipelines, facilities and/or plants) and the transportation and/or disposal of hydrocarbon transportation capacity under the
      terms permitted by applicable laws; having full legal capacity to acquire rights and/or enter into obligations and/or perform all acts that are not prohibited by law or its bylaws (including fulfilling mandates and commissions). To achieve its
      purpose, it may also carry out any type of financial operations in general, excluding those provided for in the Financial Institutions Act.</div>

Meanwhile, in November 2024, the monthly economic activity estimator (&#8220;EMAE&#8221;) recorded a year-on-year decline of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageIncreaseDecreaseOfEconomicActivity" id="Fact_4e5ca214dd284160a63a5475cac6275b" contextRef="c20241101to20241130" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0.9</ix:nonFraction>%. During 2024, the performance of this indicator was somewhat uneven and heterogeneous depending on each sector of the economy. While energy (favored by the
                    development of Vaca Muerta) and mining showed the most significant increases, construction, industry and commerce fell compared to 2023.</div>
                </td>

          taking. At the time of its inauguration, unfavorable macroeconomic conditions and uncertainty regarding the political governability of the new administration led to the adoption of a series of measures within the framework of an emergency scheme
          aimed at eliminating the fiscal deficit (via a strong fiscal adjustment), reducing monetary issuance to zero by the BCRA (with the consequent drop in inflation), and readjusting relative prices, especially for public services.</div>

          had previously received partial approval from the Senate. Among other issues, the Basic Law includes:</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal;">The <span style="font-style: italic;">Ley Bases</span> has been challenged by various sectors of the economy and the political spectrum and has
          been challenged in court, however, this is of utmost importance for the economic and institutional restructuring and recovery of the country.</div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d77" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d78">

          <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d78" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d79">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Although some of the reforms proposed by the <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: italic;">Ley Bases</span> have already been
            implemented, others are in the process of being regulated and discussed by the legislature. For this reason, at the date of issue of the Report, it is not possible to foresee the impact that the <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: italic;">Ley Bases</span> and the fiscal package could have on the results, financial situation and cash flow of the Company. However, given the financial situation of <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, it is estimated that it will be able to continue to meet its financial commitments in the near future.</div>
</ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d79" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d80">

          </div>

<div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal;">On April 11, 2025, the Government announced the launch of the next phase of its macroeconomic plan, which includes, among other measures: (i)
            allowing the exchange rate of the U.S. dollar in the official foreign exchange market (MULC) to fluctuate within a moving band between ARS 1,000 and ARS 1,400, with the band limits widening at a monthly rate of 1%; (ii) eliminating the &#8220;d&#243;lar
            blend&#8221; mechanism, lifting foreign exchange restrictions for individuals, allowing profit distributions to foreign shareholders starting from fiscal years beginning in 2025, and relaxing deadlines for foreign trade payments; and (iii)
            reinforcing the nominal anchor by enhancing the monetary policy framework, under which the Central Bank will not issue pesos to finance the fiscal deficit or to remunerate its monetary liabilities.</div>
</ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d81" continuedAt="Text_942f688b95b645f88ff6cfaf9e9e1f5d82">

<div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal;">The context of volatility and uncertainty continues at the date of issue of these consolidated financial statements. Government measures already
            implemented, or those that may be implemented in the future, could eventually affect the results of operations, financial situation and assets of the Company.</div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal;">Likewise, the Company&#8217;s management permanently monitors the evolution of the variables that affect its business, to define its course of action
          and identify the potential impacts on its equity and financial situation. The reforms proposed by the new government began their legislative discussion process. It is not possible to predict at this time its evolution or new measures that could
          be announced. Likewise, the Company cannot guarantee that the aforementioned macroeconomic difficulties or the adoption of new measures by the Argentine Government to control inflation may affect its operations and financial situation.</div>

      fiscal year. Estimates are used when accounting for the allowance for doubtful accounts, income taxes, provisions for legal claims and others, depreciations and recoverable value of assets. Actual results could be significantly different from such
      estimates.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The new accounting standards, amendments and interpretations issued by the IASB that became effective as of January 1, 2024 and that have not had an impact on the
          Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements are the following:</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      </div>

      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
        <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
          <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a7" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a8"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc839" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8310">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a8" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a9"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8310" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8311">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-weight: bold;">Supplier finance arrangements &#8211; Amendments to IAS 7 &#8220;Statement of cash flows&#8221; and IFRS 7 &#8220;Financial
              instruments &#8211; Disclosure&#8221;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a9" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a10"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8311" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8312">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a10" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a11"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8312" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8313">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">In May 2023, the IASB has issued new reporting requirements on supplier financing arrangements. The
              modifications include new requirements for qualitative and quantitative information regarding financing agreements with financial providers that allow evaluating the effects of these agreements on liabilities, cash flows and exposure to
              liquidity risk.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a11" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a12"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8313" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8314">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a12" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a13"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8314" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8315">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Supplier financing arrangements are those characterized by: (i) a financial provider paying the amount that an
              entity owes to its commercial supplier and (ii) the entity pays the financial provider, according to the terms of the agreement.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a13" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a14"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8315" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8316">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a14" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a15"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8316" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8317">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">The application of this accounting standard did not have a significant impact on the Company&#180;s consolidated
              financial statements.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a15" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a16"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8317" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8318">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"> <br/>
            </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">
              <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a16" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a17"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8318" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8319">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Amendments to IAS 1 - Classification of Liabilities as Current or Non-current and Non-current liabilities with
                covenants</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
              <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a17" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a18"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8319" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8320">
<div style="text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;"> <br/>
              </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
              <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a18" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a19"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8320" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8321">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;"><span style="font-weight: normal;">Amendments made to IAS 1 clarify that liabilities are classified as either current
                  or non-current, depending on the rights that exist at the end of the reporting period. Classification is unaffected by the entity&#8217;s expectations or events after the reporting date (for example, the receipt of a waiver or a breach of
                  covenant that an entity is required to comply with only after the reporting period).</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
              <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a19" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a20"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8321" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8322">
<div><br/>
                </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a20" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a21"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8322" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8323">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Covenants







































                    of loan arrangements will not affect classification of a liability as current or non-current at the reporting date if the entity must only comply with the covenants after the reporting date. However, if the entity must comply with a
                    covenant either on or before the reporting date, this needs to be considered in the classification as current or non-current even if the covenant is only tested for compliance after the reporting date.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a21" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a22"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8323" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8324">

<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"> <br/>
                    </span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a26" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a27"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8328" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8329">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
                        In September 2022, the IASB finalized narrow-scope amendments to the requirements for sale and leaseback transactions in IFRS 16 - Leases which explain how an entity accounts for a sale and leaseback after the date of the
                        transaction.</span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a27" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a28"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8329" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8330">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
                        <br/>
                      </span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a28" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a29"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8330" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8331">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">The







































                    amendments specify that, in measuring the lease liability subsequent to the sale and leaseback, the seller-lessee determines &#8216;lease payments&#8217; and &#8216;revised lease payments&#8217; in a way that does not result in the seller-lessee recognizing
                    any amount of the gain or loss that relates to the right of use that it retains. This could particularly impact sale and leaseback transactions where the lease payments include variable payments that do not depend on an index or a rate.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a29" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a30"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8331" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8332">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><br/>
                  <span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">The amendments are
                        applicable for annual periods beginning on or after January 1, 2024. Early application is permitted. Allows application to transactions made after the date of initial application of the amendment.<br/>

                      </span></span></span></div>

<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">The







































                        application of this accounting standard did not have significant impact on the Company&#180;s consolidated financial statements.<br/>
                      </span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a32" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a33"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8334" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8335">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
                        <br/>
                      </span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a33" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a34"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8335" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8336">
<div style="text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">4.a.2) New IFRS
                  Accounting standards issued that are not yet effective for the year beginning January 1, 2024.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a34" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a35"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8336" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8337">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><br/>
                      </span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a35" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a36"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8337" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8338">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">The







































                        IFRS accounting standards that potentially have an impact on the Company, which are not mandatory and have not been adopted early in the year beginning January 1, 2024, are listed below.<br/>
                      </span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a36" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a37"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8338" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8339">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><br/>
                      </span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a37" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a38"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8339" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8340">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">On









                        August 15, 2023, CNV General Resolution No. 972/2023 was published in the BO, which indicates that the early application of IFRS Accounting Standards and/or its modifications will not be admitted, unless the CNV specifically admits
                        it.<br/>
                        <br/>
                      </span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
              </div>

            </div>

            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a38" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a39"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8340" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8341">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-weight: bold;">Amendments to IAS 21&#8211; Lack of exchangeability<br/>
              <br/>
            </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a39" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a40"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8341" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8342">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">On August 15, 2023, the IASB issued the modification to IAS 21 called &#8220;Lack of exchangeability&#8221; to provide
              guidelines in the latter case. The amendment requires entities to apply a consistent approach to evaluating whether a currency can be exchanged for another currency, and if not, determining the exchange rate to use for measurement purposes
              and the disclosures that need to be provided in its financial statements.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a40" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a41"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8342" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8343">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a41" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a42"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8343" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8344">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Once the absence of exchangeability between currencies has been identified, the exchange rate must be
              estimated that represents that which would be obtained in an orderly transaction between market participants and that reflects economic conditions. These modifications do not specify a methodology for estimating the exchange rate to be used,
              but rather it must be developed by each entity.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a42" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a43"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8344" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8345">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a43" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a44"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8345" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8346">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">The amendments are effective for annual reporting periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025. Early
              adoption is permitted.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: bold;"> <br/>
              </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a47" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a48"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8349" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8350">

              <ix:continuation id="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a57" continuedAt="Text_f24abaa93c124efd95603f7792937a7a58"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8359" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8360">

                Subsidiaries without Public Accountability: Disclosures</div>

                    19, published by the IASB, focuses on financial reporting by non-public interest subsidiaries. This standard allows these subsidiaries to disclose reduced information compared to other IFRS Accounting Standards, which simplifies the
                    preparation of their financial statements and reduces costs, while maintaining the usefulness of the information for users.</span><br/>

                    if:</span></div>

<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">On 30 May 2024, the IASB issued targeted amendments to IFRS 9 Financial Instruments and IFRS 7 Financial Instruments: Disclosures to respond to recent questions arising in practice, and to include new requirements not only for
                      financial institutions but also for corporate entities. These amendments: (i) clarify the date of recognition and derecognition of some financial assets and liabilities, with a new exception for some financial liabilities settled
                      through an electronic cash transfer system; (ii) clarify and add further guidance for assessing whether a financial asset meets the solely payments of principal and interest (SPPI) criterion; (iii) add new disclosures for certain
                      instruments with contractual terms that can change cash flows (such as some financial instruments with features linked to the achievement of environment, social and governance targets); and (iv) update the disclosures for equity
                      instruments designated at fair value through other comprehensive income (FVOCI).</span><br/>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">4.b.1) Subsidiaries</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c3" continuedAt="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c4"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8377" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8378">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c4" continuedAt="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c5"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8378" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8379">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Subsidiaries are all entities over which the Company has control. The Company controls an entity when the Company is exposed to, or has rights to, variable returns
        from its involvement and has the ability to affect those returns through its power over the entity. Subsidiaries are fully consolidated from the date on which control is transferred to the group. They are deconsolidated from the date that control
        ceases. For this purpose and unless there are specific requirements, it is generally considered that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has control, when it has a participation greater than 50% of the available voting rights.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c5" continuedAt="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c6"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8379" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc8380">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The accounting policies of the subsidiaries are consistent with the accounting policies adopted by the Company.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">4.b.2) Associates<br/>
        </span> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c28" continuedAt="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c29"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83102" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83103">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Associates are entities over which the group has significant influence but not control, generally accompanying a shareholding of between 20% and 50% of the voting
        rights. Investments in associates are accounted for using the equity method of accounting. Under the equity method, the investment is initially recognized at cost, and the carrying amount is increased or decreased to recognize the investor&#8217;s share
        of the profit or loss of the investee after the date of acquisition.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c29" continuedAt="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c30"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83103" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83104">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
        <ix:continuation id="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c30" continuedAt="Text_ac0700990a0a47508bee61d7fd21a28c31"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83104" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83105">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company accounted for the investments in its associates, under the equity method&#160; on the basis on the financial statements as of September

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">4.c.1) Functional and presentation currency</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83127" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83128"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c3" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c4">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83128" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83129"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c4" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c5">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The consolidated financial statements are presented in thousands of Argentine Pesos, which is the Company&#8217;s functional currency restated to reflect the effects of
        inflation as indicated in Note 4.d). Each subsidiary or associate determines its own functional currency based on the currency of the primary economic environment in which these entities operate.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83129" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83130"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c5" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c6">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83130" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83131"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c6" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c7">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">4.c.2) Transactions and
        balances</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83131" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83132"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c7" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c8">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83132" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83133"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c8" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c9">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Foreign currency transactions are translated into the functional currency using the exchange rates at the dates of the transactions. Foreign exchange gains and losses
        resulting from the settlement of such transactions, and from the translation of monetary assets and liabilities denominated in foreign currencies at reporting date exchange rates, are recorded in the Statement of Comprehensive Income within
        financial income and financial expenses, as appropriate.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83133" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83134"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c9" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c10">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83134" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83135"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c10" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c11">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">4.c.3) Associates</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83135" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83136"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c11" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c12">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
        <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83136" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83137"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c12" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c13">
<div style="margin: 0px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The functional currency of the associate company TGU was the US dollar, because it was the currency in which it substantially generated its income and
          incurred its expenses. Assets and liabilities were converted into Argentine pesos using the exchange rate prevailing at the end of each year, their common stock and retained earnings at their historical exchange rates and results at average
          exchange rates.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83137" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83138"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c13" continuedAt="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c14">

        <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83138" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83139"><ix:continuation id="Text_75d1ee8795d64efbbc133839fdefe04c14">
<div style="margin: 0px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> On December 26, 2024, said company was liquidated, so no balances are recorded for it as of December 31, 2024.<br/>
