      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83141" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83142"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f1" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f2">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 14.4pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83142" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83143"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f2" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f3">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">4.d.1) Regulatory framework</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83143" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83144"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f3" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f4">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83144" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83145"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f4" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f5">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2024, including comparative figures, have been restated to take into account changes in the general purchasing
        power of the Company&#8217;s functional currency (the Argentine peso) in accordance with IAS 29 &#8220;Financial Reporting in hyperinflationary economies&#8221; (&#8220;IAS 29&#8221;) and CNV General Resolution No. 777/2018. As a result, the financial statements are stated in
        terms of the current unit of measurement at the 2024 balance sheet date.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83145" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83146"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f5" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f6">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83146" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83147"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f6" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f7">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">IAS 29 requires that the financial statements of an entity that reports in the currency of a hyperinflationary economy, regardless of whether they are based on the
        historical cost method or the current cost method, are expressed in terms of the current unit of measurement at the closing date of the reporting period. In order to conclude on the existence of a hyperinflationary economy, the standard details a
        series of factors to be considered, among which is a cumulative inflation rate over three years that approaches or exceeds 100%.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83147" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83148"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f7" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f8">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83148" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83149"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f8" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f9">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The accumulated inflation in three years is over 100%. Likewise, both the National Government projections and other available projections indicate that this trend will
        not be reversed in the short term.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83149" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83150"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f9" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f10">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83150" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83151"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f10" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f11">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">To evaluate the aforementioned quantitative condition, and also to restate the financial statements, the CNV has established that the series of indexes to be used for
        the application of IAS 29 is determined by the FACPCE. This series of indexes combines the National Consumer Price Index (&#8220;CPI&#8221;) as of January 2017 (base month: December 2016) with the Domestic Wholesale Price Index (&#8220;WPI&#8221;), both published by the
        Institute National Statistics and Census (&#8220;INDEC&#8221;) until that date. For the months of November and December 2015, for which there is no information from the INDEC on the evolution of the WPI, the variation in the CPI of the Autonomous City of
        Buenos Aires was applied.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83151" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83152"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f11" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f12">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83152" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83153"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f12" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f13">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Considering the aforementioned index, inflation was <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:InflationRatePercentage" id="Fact_db5a34b426884a77ae043b8c1d128541" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">117.8</ix:nonFraction>%,
        <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:InflationRatePercentage" id="Fact_5cbb39234da74518bcd75cb45a23ec35" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">211.4</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:InflationRatePercentage" id="Fact_3f35efdccc004af5ab229686be0a2bf1" contextRef="c20220101to20221231" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">94.8</ix:nonFraction>% in the
        years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022 respectively.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83153" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83154"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f13" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f14">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">4.d.2) Restatement mechanism</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83155" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83156"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f15" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f16">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83156" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83157"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f16" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f17">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The financial statements must be adjusted to consider changes in the general purchasing power of the currency, so that they are expressed in the current unit of
        measurement at the end of the reporting period. Said requirements also include all the comparative information of the financial statements, without modifying the decisions made based on the financial information corresponding to those financial
        years.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The figures as of December 31, 2023 and 2022, which are presented in these Consolidated Financial Statements for comparative purposes, arise from the restatement to
        the current unit of measure of the Financial Statements as of said dates, in accordance with IAS 29.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83159" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83160"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f19" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f20">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83160" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83161"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f20" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f21">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Restatement of the balance sheet</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83161" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83162"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f21" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f22">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83162" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83163"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f22" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f23">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt; text-indent: -9pt;">i. Monetary items (those with a fixed nominal value in local currency) are not restated, since they are already expressed in the
        current unit of measurement at the closing date of the reporting period. In an inflationary period, maintaining monetary assets generates loss of purchasing power and maintaining monetary liabilities generates a gain in purchasing power, provided
        that such items are not subject to an adjustment mechanism that compensates to some extent for these effects. The monetary loss or gain is included in the result of the period in which it is reported.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83163" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83164"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f23" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f24">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83164" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83165"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f24" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f25">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt; text-indent: -9pt;">ii. The non-monetary items measured at their current values at the end of the reporting period are not restated for the purpose
        of their presentation in the balance sheet, but the adjustment process must be completed to determine in terms of a homogeneous unit of measurement the results produced by the holding of these non-monetary items.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83165" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83166"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f25" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f26">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83166" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83167"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f26" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f27">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt; text-indent: -9pt;">iii. The non-monetary items measured at historical cost or at a fair value as of a date prior to the closing date of the
        reporting period are restated by coefficients that reflect the variation in the general price level from the date of acquisition or revaluation to the closing date, proceeding then to compare the restated amounts of those assets with the
        corresponding recoverable values.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83167" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83168"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f27" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f28">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83168" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83169"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f28" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f29">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt; text-indent: -9pt;">iv. The restatement of non-monetary assets in the terms of the current unit of measurement at the end of the reporting period
        without an equivalent adjustment for tax purposes, results in a temporary taxable difference and the recognition of a deferred tax liability whose counterparty is recognized in the result of the period. For the closing of the subsequent period, the
        deferred tax items are restated for inflation to re-determine the charge to the result of the next period.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83169" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83170"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f29" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f30">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83170" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83171"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f30" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f31">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt; text-indent: -9pt;">v. When the capitalization of costs for loans in non-monetary assets in accordance with IAS 23 is applicable, the portion of
        those costs that compensate the lender for the effects of inflation is not capitalized.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83171" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83172"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f31" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f32">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Restatement of the Comprehensive Income Statement</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83173" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83174"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f33" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f34">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83174" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83175"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f34" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f35">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Revenues and expenses (including interest and foreign exchange differences) are restated from the date of their booking, except for those items of the result that
        reflect or include in their determination the consumption of assets measured in purchasing power of a date before the consumption booked, which are restated based on the date of origin of the asset to which the item is related (for example,
        depreciation and other consumption of assets valued at historical cost); and also those results that arise from comparing two measurements expressed in purchasing power currency of different dates, for which it is necessary to identify the amounts
        compared, restate them separately, and make the comparison, but with the amounts already restated.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83175" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83176"><ix:continuation id="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f35" continuedAt="Text_037e2099381b48b4addf2b3a6d5a3e6f36">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The result of the exposure to the change in the purchasing power of the currency (monetary results) is presented in a separate line and reflects the effect of

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83228" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83229"><ix:continuation id="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d32" continuedAt="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d33">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Unrealized gains or losses arising from changes in fair value are recognized as other comprehensive income, except for the accrual of interest, exchange rate
        difference and the impairment of such assets that are recognized as financial results in the Statement of Comprehensive Income. At the time the asset is written off, the accumulated gain or loss is recognized as a financial result and it is
        eliminated from the respective reserve.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83229" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83230"><ix:continuation id="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d33" continuedAt="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d34">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the Company has not recognized any financial assets under this category.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Financial assets
        designated at fair value through OCI (equity instruments)</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Upon initial recognition, the Company can elect to classify irrevocably its equity investments as equity instruments designated at fair value through OCI when they
        meet the definition of equity under IAS 32.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Gains and losses on these financial assets are never recycled to profit or loss. Dividends are recognized as other income in the Statement of Comprehensive Income when
        the right of payment has been established, except when the Company benefits from such proceeds as a recovery of part of the cost of the financial asset, in which case, such gains are recorded in OCI. Equity instruments designated at fair value
        through OCI are not subject to impairment assessment.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company applies the Expected Credit loss (&#8220;ECL&#8221;) model for those financial assets accounted for at amortized cost or at fair value through OCI. The ECL is based on
        the difference between the contractual cash flows due in accordance with the contract and the cash flows that the Company expects to receive, discounted at an approximation of the original effective interest rate. To this end, the Company evaluates
        various factors, including credit risk, historical trends and other available information.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">All financial liabilities are initially recognized at fair value net of transaction costs.</div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83266" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83267"><ix:continuation id="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d70" continuedAt="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d71">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">They are classified in current liabilities, except those whose maturity exceeds twelve months, which are classified as non-current liabilities.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Financial liabilities

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">The Company includes financial liabilities with fixed or determinable payments that are not quoted in an active market.
          Current liabilities are included, except those whose maturity exceeds twelve months including premiums, discounts and direct expenses, which are included as non-current liabilities. They are measured using the effective interest method. As of
          December 31, 2024 and 2023, all of the Company&#8217;s financial liabilities were classified in this category.<br/>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83280" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83281"><ix:continuation id="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d84" continuedAt="Text_2cec1d4136de4945940361f7d4ea792d85">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Financial assets and liabilities are offset when there is a legally enforceable right to offset the recognized amounts and there is an intention to settle on a net
        basis, or realize the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83285" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83286"><ix:continuation id="Text_af829ee8976a4616ad5af5ba8d1592cc2" continuedAt="Text_af829ee8976a4616ad5af5ba8d1592cc3">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> Derivative financial instruments are recognized at their fair value at inception and subsequently measured at their fair value and disclosed as assets or liabilities
        depending on if it is gain or loss. The results of derivative financial instruments are classified under &#8220;Financial income / expenses&#8221; in the Statement of Comprehensive Income, or in the other comprehensive income if hedge accounting is applied.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83286" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83287"><ix:continuation id="Text_af829ee8976a4616ad5af5ba8d1592cc3">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
        Derivative financial instruments are measured in accordance with IFRS 13 &#8220;Fair value measurement&#8221;.<br/>
        <br/>
        The method of recognizing the resulting gain or loss depends on whether the derivative is designated as a hedging instrument or not and, according to the nature of the item being hedged.<br/>
      </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Trade receivables are amounts due from customers for goods and services performed in the ordinary course of business.
          Contract assets are unbilled amounts due to customers related to works in progress.<br/>
        </span> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83301" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83302"><ix:continuation id="Text_0502c3fb066b40e18450a85327948d733" continuedAt="Text_0502c3fb066b40e18450a85327948d734">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Trade receivables, contract assets and other receivables are recognized initially at fair value and subsequently measured
          at amortized cost using the effective interest method, less allowance for trade receivables.<br/>
        </span> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83302" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83303"><ix:continuation id="Text_0502c3fb066b40e18450a85327948d734" continuedAt="Text_0502c3fb066b40e18450a85327948d735">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company applies the simplified approach to measuring expected credit losses for trade receivables, contract assets and other receivables. For this purpose,
        customers have been grouped based on shared credit risk characteristics, the existence of guarantees, historical credit losses experienced and the existence of judicial proceedings aimed at obtaining payment. Once each group was defined, an
        expected uncollectibility rate calculated based on historic default rates adjusted to future economic conditions was defined.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83303" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83304"><ix:continuation id="Text_0502c3fb066b40e18450a85327948d735" continuedAt="Text_0502c3fb066b40e18450a85327948d736">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">If an impairment loss is recognized, the book amount of the asset is reduced through a provision account and the amount of the loss is recognized in the Statement of Comprehensive Income at the time it occurs. If in subsequent periods the
          amount of the impairment loss decreases, the reverse of the same is also recorded in the Statement of Comprehensive Income</span><span style="font-size: 10pt;">.</span></div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83329" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83330"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399519" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399520">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">In accordance with IAS 23, the Company capitalizes financial expense on long term construction projects, until the moment in which the asset is in conditions for
            its use. Capitalization of borrowing costs is carried out considering the provisions of IAS 29, recording as an expense in the Statement of Comprehensive Income the part of the borrowing costs that compensates for inflation during the same
            period. For the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, there have not been capitalized borrowing costs.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83330" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83331"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399520" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399521">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83331" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83332"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399521" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399522">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Depreciation related to natural gas transportation assets is computed under the straight-line method over the estimated useful lives of the specific assets, which
            are not exceeding the maximum useful lives established by ENARGAS through Resolutions 1660 and 1903.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83332" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83333"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399522" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399523">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83333" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83334"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399523" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399524">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">For depreciation of all other PPE, the Company uses the straight-line method of depreciation based on the useful life assigned to each item.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83334" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83335"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399524" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399525">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83335" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83336"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399525" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399526">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Major maintenance costs are depreciated according to the estimated time until the next major maintenance planned. Regarding the capitalized financial costs, they
            are depreciated based on the remaining useful lives of those components of PPE that originated such capitalization.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        </div>

<div style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify;">The assets&#8217; residual values and useful lives are reviewed,
          and adjusted if appropriate, at each reporting date. For further information, see Note 12.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83338" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83339"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399528" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399529">
<div><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
          </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83339" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83340"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399529" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399530">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The result generated by the disposal of PPE components is recognized in the year in which it is generated.</div>

<div><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83341" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83342"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399531" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399532">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Impairment of non-financial assets:</span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"> The Company&#8217;s Management assesses at each reporting period whether there is an indication that an individual component or a group of PPE may be
            impaired.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83342" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83343"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399532" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399533">

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <div>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83343" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83344"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399533" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399534">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">If any indication exists, the Company estimates the asset&#180;s recoverable amount. An asset&#180;s recoverable amount is the higher of the fair value less costs to sell
            that asset, and its value-in-use.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83344" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83345"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399534" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399535">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>

          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83345" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83346"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399535" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399536">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">That amount is determined for and individual asset, unless the asset does not generate cash inflows that are largely independent of those from other assets or
            groups of assets; in which case, the cash flows of the group of assets that form part of the cash-generating unit (&#8220;CGU&#8221;) to which the belong are taken.</div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Where the carrying amount of an individual asset or CGU exceeds its recoverable amount, the individual asset or CGU, as the case may be, is considered impaired and
            is written down to its recoverable amount. Impairment losses are recognized in the consolidated statement of comprehensive income.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83348" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83349"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399538" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399539">

          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83349" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83350"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399539" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399540">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">In assessing value in use, the estimated future cash flows are discounted to their present value using a pre-tax discount rate that reflects current market
            assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the asset for which the estimates of future cash flows have not been adjusted. To such end, the Company makes estimates and assumptions of the economic conditions that will
            prevail throughout the useful life of the assets.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83350" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83351"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399540" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399541">

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">As a result of the factors mentioned above, actual cash flows and values could vary significantly from projected cash flows and the values derived from the
            discounting techniques used.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the
              book value of PPE did not exceed its recoverable value.</span></div>

<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">A previously recognized impairment loss is
              reversed only if there has been a change in the assumptions used to determine the recoverable amount of the individual asset or CGU since the last time an impairment loss was recognized. The reversal is limited so that the carrying amount of
              the asset or CGU does not exceed its recoverable amount, nor exceed the carrying amount that would have been determined, net of applicable depreciation, if an impairment loss had not been recognized for that asset or CGU in prior periods.
              Such a reversal is recognized in the income statement on the same line item in which the respective impairment charge was previously recognized, unless the asset is carried at its revalued amount, in which case the reversal is treated
              similarly to a revaluation increase.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Infrastructure used in the natural gas transportation service: </span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">for its measurement and disclosure, the Company has evaluated the application of Interpretation No. 12 &#8220;Service
                  Concession Agreements&#8221; (IFRIC 12) that sets the guidelines for the accounting of private entities that provide public services through a service concession agreement or a contract of a similar nature.</span></div>

              <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">
                <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83362" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83363"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399552" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399553">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Considering the current terms and conditions of the License, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> concluded that the License is outside the scope of
                  IFRIC 12, as it is considered in substance to provide for an indefinite term because the infrastructure will never revert to the grantor and due to the characteristics of renewal of the License that give a similar result to what which
                  would result from having obtained a perpetual right to operate the infrastructure.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83363" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83364"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399553" continuedAt="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399554">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
                  </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83364" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83365"><ix:continuation id="Text_45aa6e8849b04969a342c92d1292399554">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The evaluation carried out and the conclusions reached by <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> are consistent with those of other transportation and
                  natural gas distribution companies in Argentina that are subject to the similar regulations and license agreements. The evaluation was carried out jointly, when the transportation and distribution companies adopted the IFRS Accounting
                  Standards in Argentina in 2012, together with the FACPCE, the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange (<span style="font-style: italic;">Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos</span> - &#8220;BYMA&#8221;) and the CNV, considering the contributions of ENARGAS with respect
                  to the regulatory aspects of the License agreements. In this regard, the CNV issued General Resolution No. 613/2012, ratifying that IFRIC 12 does not apply to natural gas transportation and distribution licenses established under the
                  regulatory framework described in Note 17.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 18pt;">
                  <div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">4.k)</div>
                </td>

    <td style="align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                  <div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Leases</div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83367" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83368"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80091" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80092">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83368" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83369"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80092" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80093">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Leases are recognized as a right-of-use asset and a corresponding liability at the date on which the leased asset is available for use by the Company. Each lease
        payment is allocated between the liability and the finance cost. The finance cost is expensed over the lease term to produce a constant periodic interest rate on the remaining balance of the liability for each period. The right-of-use asset is
        depreciated over the shorter of the useful life of the asset or the term of the contract.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83369" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83370"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80093" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80094">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83370" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83371"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80094" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80095">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Assets and liabilities arising from a lease are initially measured based on the present value of the lease. Liabilities include the net present value of the following
        lease payments:</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83371" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83372"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80095" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80096">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div>
        <div>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83372" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83373"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80096" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80097">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 36pt;"><span style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">a)</span> </span>Fixed
            payments, less any incentive receivable;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        </div>

      </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83373" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83374"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80097" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80098">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">b)</span> Variable lease payments;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83374" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83375"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80098" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80099">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">c)</span> Amounts expected to be collected as a guarantee of the residual value;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83375" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83376"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b80099" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800910">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">d)</span> The exercise price of the lease option; and</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83376" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83377"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800910" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800911">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">e)</span> Penalty payments for termination of the lease.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83377" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83378"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800911" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800912">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83378" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83379"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800912" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800913">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Lease payments are discounted using the interest rate implicit in the lease. If such rate cannot be determined, the Company&#8217;s incremental borrowing rate is used, which
        is the rate that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> would have to pay to borrow the funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value in a similar economic environment.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83379" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83380"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800913" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800914">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83380" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83381"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800914" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800915">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Right-of-use assets are measured at cost which comprises the following:</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83381" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83382"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800915" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800916">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83382" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83383"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800916" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800917">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">a)</span> The amount of the initial measurement of the lease liability;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83383" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83384"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800917" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800918">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">b)</span> Any lease payments made on or before the commencement date less any lease incentives received;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83384" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83385"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800918" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800919">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">c)</span> Any initial direct costs; and</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83385" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83386"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800919" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800920">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">d)</span> Restoration costs</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83386" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83387"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800920" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800921">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%29%F-%%-->
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83387" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83388"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800921" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800922">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">These assets, which are subject to the risk of impairment, are depreciated on a straight-line basis over the shorter of the useful life of the leased asset or the
        lease term.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83388" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83389"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800922" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800923">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83389" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83390"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800923" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800924">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Payments associated with short-term leases and low-value assets are recognized on a straight-line basis as an expense in the Statement of Income. Short-term leases are
        those with a term of 12 months or less. Low-value assets comprise computer equipment, vehicles, small items of office furniture and real estate.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83390" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83391"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800924" continuedAt="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800925">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83391" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83392"><ix:continuation id="Text_82709d1fe98b4b3797995438a89b800925">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company has rights to use assets that are shown as part of Property, plant and equipment (see Note 12). Lease liabilities are shown under Financial Debt (see Note
        13). For further information regarding the expense related to short-term and low value leases and the interest expense on lease liabilities, see Note 8.j. and 8.k., respectively.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Loans have been initially recorded at fair value net of direct attributable transaction costs. Subsequently, loans are valued at their amortized cost. Liabilities are
        disclosed as non-current when their maturity exceeds twelve months.</div>

        relate to income tax levied by the same tax authority on the same taxable entity or different taxable entities that intend to settle tax assets and liabilities on a net basis. Deferred tax assets are recognized to the extent that it is probable
        that future taxable income will be generated against which the temporary differences can be used.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_9205adbfee6748eea3496a80454cd2b119" continuedAt="Text_9205adbfee6748eea3496a80454cd2b120"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83420" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83421">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_9205adbfee6748eea3496a80454cd2b120"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83421" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83422">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The assets and liabilities generated by the application of the deferred tax were valued at their nominal amount considering the restatements for inflation mentioned in
        Note 4.d) and are classified as non-current assets or liabilities.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company has recorded provisions related to legal actions, judicial court, claims and administrative proceedings, including interpretive questions of the current
        legislation and those of regulatory nature.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Provisions for legal claims and/or claims by third parties (&#8220;legal claims and others&#8221;) are recorded at the expected cancellation value when the Company has a present
        obligation as a result of a past event, it is probable that an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation; and the amount has been reliably estimated. Estimates are reviewed and adjusted, as the Company obtains additional
        information to be received.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Natural Gas Transportation</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da89" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da810"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83438" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83439">

        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da810" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da811"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83439" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83440">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Natural Gas transportation services includes: (i) firm natural gas transportation, whose revenues are recognized when the capacity is reserved and paid for regardless
        of actual usage by the customer, (ii) interruptible natural gas transportation and exchange and displacement services whose revenues are recognized when services are rendered and (iii) the operation and maintenance service of the assets affected by
        the natural gas transportation service corresponding to the expansions promoted by the National Government and whose ownership corresponds to the trusts created for such purpose whose revenues are recognized when services are rendered.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da811" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da812"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83440" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83441">

        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da812" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da813"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83441" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83442">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The applicable rates arise from the tariff tables published by ENARGAS. Thus Company&#8217;s revenues are recognized by the amount for which it will be entitled to receive
        as consideration.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da813" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da814"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83442" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83443">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da814" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da815"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83443" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83444">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">At the end of each month, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> recognizes, over the time, its revenues from sales equivalent to the firm reserved capacity, the
        volumes of natural gas transported under the modalities of interruptible and exchange and displacement and by the operation and maintenance services. In return, a trade receivable is recognized which represents an unconditional right that the
        Company has to receive the consideration owed by the customer. On the other hand, the billing of the service is done monthly and according to the guidelines established by ENARGAS, the consideration is received within said calendar month.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da815" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da816"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83444" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83445">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da816" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da817"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83445" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83446">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Liquids Production and Commercialization</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da817" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da818"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83446" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83447">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da818" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da819"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83447" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83448">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">This business segment includes: (i) production and commercialization of liquids, and (ii) other liquid services.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da819" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da820"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83448" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83449">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da820" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da821"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83449" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83450">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Liquids Production and Commercialization in the domestic market</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da821" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da822"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83450" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83451">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da822" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da823"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83451" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83452">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In the domestic market, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> sells the production of propane and butane to LPG retailers in the framework of the programs
        created by the National Government to supply the domestic market. The sale prices are determined by the ex-Secretary of Hydrocarbon Resources (&#8220;SHR&#8221;). For more information, see Note 17.b) - Regulatory framework - Regulatory framework for
        non-regulated segments - to these consolidated financial statements.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da823" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da824"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83452" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83453">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da824" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da825"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83453" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83454">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The price of those tons of propane and butane that are not sold within the framework of the aforementioned programs is determined by the Secretary of Energy based on
        the international reference prices.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da825" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da826"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83454" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83455">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da826" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da827"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83455" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83456">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Regarding ethane sales, they are made to PBB Polisur S.R.L. (&#8220;PBB&#8221;), the only customer to whom this product is sold. To estimate transaction price, the Company uses
        the most probable amount method. In this regard, the Company only recognizes those transactions where it is highly probable that they will not be reversed in the future.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da827" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da828"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83456" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83457">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da828" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da829"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83457" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83458">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Liquids Production and Commercialization in the foreign market</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da829" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da830"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83458" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83459">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da830" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da831"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83459" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83460">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In the foreign market, the Company markets propane, butane and natural gasoline to international traders (&#8220;traders&#8221;) and other clients of worldwide renown, some of
        them through trucks.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da831" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da832"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83460" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83461">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da832" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da833"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83461" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83462">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">These sales are made under short-term contracts (less than one year), with the price determined as reference to international prices plus / minus a fixed amount per
        ton sold.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da833" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da834"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83462" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83463">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da834" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da835"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83463" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83464">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">For both domestic and foreign market sales, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> transfers control and recognizes revenues when the products are delivered to
        the customer and therefore the product has been accepted and there is no evidence of the existence of pending obligations by the Company. It is at that moment when a trade receivable is recognized given that the receipt of the consideration is
        unconditional and only the passage of time is the only requirement for receiving the consideration owed by the customer.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da835" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da836"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83464" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83465">
<div><br/></div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Revenues are recognized when the service is effectively
        rendered, that is, after the dispatch to each vessel. The price is agreed by the parties being a fixed amount per ton of product dispatched, there being no variable components in them. These services are billed monthly, at which time an
        unconditional right to receive the consideration from the client arises.</div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da844" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da845"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83473" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83474">

        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da845" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da846"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83474" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83475">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The services included in the Midstream segment consist mainly in (i) treatment, removal of impurities and natural gas compression, including the collection and
        transport of natural gas (ii) inspection and maintenance of pipelines and compressor plants, (iii) services of steam generation for electricity production and management services for expansion works and steam generation for the production of
        electricity and (iv) natural gas transportation services in Vaca Muerta.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da846" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da847"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83475" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83476">

        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da847" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da848"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83476" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83477">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Revenues from sales of this business segment are recognized over the time in the period in which the service is provided. The sale price is determined according to
        what arises from the contractual conditions agreed between <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> and its customers. In all cases, the recognition and billing of sales income is made on a monthly basis so that at that time a sales credit is
        recorded.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da848" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da849"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83477" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83478">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
