      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da849" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da850"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83478" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83479">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Revenues from the participation in the joint venture, which correspond to the construction activities provided by the joint venture, are recognized based on the stage
        of completion of the contractual activity (percentage of completion method), considering the estimated final margin of the work. To apply the percentage of completion method, the revenue recognized at the end of the period will correspond to the
        total contractual revenue multiplied by the actual percentage of completion, based on the proportion of the total direct contractual costs incurred to date, and the total direct contractual costs, including the estimated costs to complete the
        construction. Costs incurred in excess of the costs associated with revenue are recognized in Contract assets.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da850" continuedAt="Text_eb7c33ecd60c4fd6b7697adc2cc44da851"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83479" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83480">

        The sale price is determined according to what arises from the contractual conditions agreed between Telcosur and its customers. The consideration is determined as a fixed monthly amount. In all cases, the recognition and billing of sales income is
        made on a monthly basis so that at that time a sales receivable is recorded.</div>

          Government, (for more information see &#8220;Note 17 - Regulatory Framework - b) Regulatory framework for non-regulated segments&#8221;), the Company receives from the Secretary of Energy a series of subsidies that are recognized in accordance with the
          provisions of IAS 20 &#8220;Accounting for government grants and disclosures of government assistance&#8221; because they correspond to economic compensations calculated as the difference between the sale prices of the products determined in accordance with
          the legislation in force and the reference prices calculated by the Secretary of Energy.</div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_d2e6fe72cd3c455ba855660b2279bf5724" continuedAt="Text_d2e6fe72cd3c455ba855660b2279bf5725"><ix:continuation id="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83522" continuedAt="Text_44c558e84ace4b14a29d71507a61dc83523">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The cash dividend is recognized as a liability in the Company&#8217;s financial statements in the year in which they are approved by the shareholders of the Company or the
        Board of Directors according to the powers delegated by the Shareholders&#8217; Meeting, as appropriate.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Retained earnings</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The outstanding balance of retained earnings includes accumulated gains or losses which were not allocated to a specific purpose reserve and, when positive, may be
        distributed pursuant to the decision of the Shareholders provided these retained earnings are not subject to legal restrictions, as mentioned above &#8220;Legal reserve&#8221;.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The preparation of financial statements in conformity with professional accounting standards requires the Company to make accounting estimates that affect the reported
      amounts of assets and liabilities and the disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial statements and the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the reporting period. The making of such estimates involves <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> using assumptions and presumptions that are based on a number of factors, including past trends, events known at the date of issuance of these financial statements, and expectations of future events and their
      outcomes.</div>
</ix:continuation>

</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">As mentioned in Note
          4.j), management periodically evaluates the existence of significant events or changes that could have an adverse effect on the Company or will take place in the near future that could affect the recoverable amount of PPE. PPE is tested to assess
          whether an impairment or reversal of a previous impairment is required when significant changes took place during the period or will take place in the near future indicate that the recoverable value of the PPE amounts may be affected. These
          evaluations are performed at the lowest level for which identifiable cash flows exist, i.e., for each CGU. The Management considers each business segment as a CGU.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Since August 2019, the main macroeconomic and business variables in Argentina suffered a significant deterioration. This situation was aggravated in 2020 by the negative
      consequences that COVID had on Argentina&#8217;s economic situation which led the Argentine Government to take a series of measures even affecting the regulatory framework of the natural gas transportation segment, which led to the recognition of an
      impairment of PPE in the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b19" continuedAt="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b20">

    </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Effective from April 1, 2024, ENARGAS granted a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfTransitionalAdjustmentInNaturalGasTransportationTariffs" id="Fact_fd24c25b73c54affabb9ddcde8e13aa6" contextRef="c20240401" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">675</ix:nonFraction>%
      tariff increase and successive monthly increases, and the necessary steps were also taken to complete the Five-Year Tariff Review (&#8220;RQT&#8221;), whose public hearing was held on February 6, 2025 (see Notes 1 and 17). Therefore, as of December 31, 2024, the
      cash flows used to determine the recoverable value (value in use) of the CGU related to the Natural Gas Transportation segment were re-estimated. <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b21" continuedAt="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b22">

    </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The value in use of PPE is sensitive to significant variation in the assumptions applied, including the adjustment of future tariffs determined by the Argentine
      Government in the Natural Gas Transportation segment.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b23" continuedAt="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b24">

      <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
        <div style="text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
          <ix:continuation id="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b24" continuedAt="Text_3aa6bc5f4b5a410fa12d30730151b61b25">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The value in use is calculated based on the discounted future cash flows. The projected cash flows are prepared taking into account
            significant assumptions relating to: discount rate, estimates of future tariffs and the recognition of cost adjustments and expected macroeconomic variables such as inflation and foreign exchange rates. The discount rate is based on a weighted
            average cost of capital (&#8220;WACC&#8221;).</div>
</ix:continuation>
        </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In performing the analysis for the Natural Gas Transportation segment, the Management considered among others: (i) the status of the
          negotiations with the Argentine Government, (ii) the contractual rights derived from the License, (iii) Management&#180;s expectations regarding the transitional tariff increase to be granted until the new RQT is concluded, (iv) Management&#180;s
          expectation of the outcome of the new RQT process and (v) the impact of a cost monitoring scheme that allows for semi-annual adjustments to current tariffs.</div>

        variables and assigning probabilities of occurrence based on experience and considering the current socio-economic context, as follows:</div>
</ix:continuation>

</ix:continuation>
    <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e952" continuedAt="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e953">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">IFRS 8 &#8220;Operating Segments&#8221; requires an entity to report financial and descriptive information about its reportable segments, which are operating
        segments or aggregations of operating segments that meet specified criteria. Operating segments are components of an entity about which separate financial information is available that is evaluated regularly by the chief operating decision maker
        (&#8220;CODM&#8221;) in deciding how to allocate resources and in assessing performance. The Company&#8217;s CODM is the Board of Directors.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    </div>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e953" continuedAt="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e954">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e954" continuedAt="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e955">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company analyzes its businesses into <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:NumberOfReportableSegment" id="Fact_1d5ab81a86ef4f318ad2fab352373cd3" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_SegmentConsolidationItemsAxis_OperatingSegmentsMember" unitRef="U008" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">four</ix:nonFraction> segments
      (i) Natural Gas Transportation Services, subject to ENARGAS regulations, (ii) Liquids Production and Commercialization, (iii) Midstream and (iv) Telecommunications. These last three business segments are not regulated by ENARGAS. Liquids Production
      and Commercialization business segment is regulated by the SE.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e955" continuedAt="Text_8c67e5c10b4c41f0a3dbeb075da65e956">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Non-current assets are mostly located in the entity&#180;s country of domicile.</div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd2" continuedAt="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd3">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Tax adjustment for inflation</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd3" continuedAt="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd4">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 14.2pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd4" continuedAt="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd5">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Law No. 27,468 establishes that in the net taxable income of the periods beginning on or after January 1, 2018, the adjustment for inflation obtained by the
        application of the income tax law may be deducted or incorporated into the tax result for the fiscal year. This adjustment will proceed only if the percentage variation in the IPC, will accumulate (a) a percentage higher than 100% in the 36 months
        prior to the end of the year, or (b) regarding the first, second and third fiscal year that starts from its effective date, an accumulated variation of the IPC that exceeds 55%, 30% or 15% of said 100%, respectively.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd5" continuedAt="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd6">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd6" continuedAt="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd7">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">For the fiscal years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, the CPI has exceeded the 100% threshold mentioned above, so the Company has measured the tax charge to
        earnings for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022 considering the application of the adjustment for fiscal inflation.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd7" continuedAt="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd8">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>
        <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
          <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">F-50</span></div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">According to the Solidarity Law, the positive or negative result generated by the application of the inflation adjustment corresponding to the first and second fiscal
        year beginning on January 1, 2019 will be charged in a sixth in that fiscal period and the <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:NumberOfConsecutiveMonthlyInstallments" id="Fact_5e922ee5f38e48dfaf4732ffe6ee2fa6" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U009" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">five</ix:nonFraction> sixths remaining in equal parts in the
        following 5 fiscal periods. As of January 1, 2021, <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:TaxRateEffectOfAdjustmentsForCurrentTaxOfPriorPeriods" id="Fact_ad14e1f430be4e40a99a6986bf180a98" contextRef="c20210101to20210101" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the adjustment may be deducted/taxed in the year in which the effect is
        determined.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd9" continuedAt="Text_3cc9e8380cf84957a9437b7e47d8a5dd10">

      </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">On November 16, 2022, the Senate of the Nation approved the 2023 budget bill under Law No. 27,701, which already had half a sanction from the Chamber of Deputies.<br/>
          <br/>
          The 2023 budget law incorporates article 195 to the income tax law establishing that in the event that the adjustment for tax inflation is applicable and a positive adjustment (profits) arises from it, the first and second fiscal years starting
          on 1 January 2022 inclusive, they may allocate 1/3 in that fiscal period and the remaining 2/3, in equal parts, in the 2 immediately following fiscal periods. For the deferral to be appropriate, it will be necessary for companies to make an
          investment in the purchase, construction, manufacture, processing or definitive import of fixed assets (except automobiles), during each of the 2 fiscal periods immediately following that of the calculation of the first third of the period in
          question, for an amount equal to or greater than $<ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ThresholdAdjustmentForTaxInflationForDeferralOnInvestments" id="Fact_1d0857427c994746bde9e4bd55e0d684" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_RangeAxis_BottomOfRangeMember" unitRef="U007" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">30,000,000,000</ix:nonFraction>.<br/>
          <br/>
          As of December 31, 2023, the Company projected investments in PPE in accordance with the requirements mentioned above, determining that the amounts exceed what is established by law.</span><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">As of December 31, 2021, the Company had a specific tax carryforward derived from negative exchange differences for the years 2021 and 2020 generated by financial
        instruments traded abroad for Ps. <span style="font-size: 10pt;"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:GainsLossesOnHedgingInstrument" id="Fact_fbb6a636b9604dfb919423102743e99b" contextRef="c20210101to20211231_TemporaryDifferenceUnusedTaxLossesAndUnusedTaxCreditsAxis_UnrealisedForeignExchangeGainsLossesMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">7,974,955</ix:nonFraction>. The realization of such tax loss depended on the future
          generation of taxable financial gains taxed during the statute of limitations period. To determine its recoverability, the Company took into consideration the reversal of the deferred items, its tax planning and projections of future specific
          taxable income based on its best estimate. Based on these projections and because it <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">was not possible to estimate as probable the generation of future specific financial gains to absorb such tax loss, no deferred tax asset of </span>Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:UnusedTaxLossesForWhichNoDeferredTaxAssetRecognised" id="Fact_116af710bafb4a4c916549b56fc1bff9" contextRef="c20211231" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">794,334</ix:nonFraction> was recognized as of December 31, 2021. <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">During the year ended on December 31, 2022, the tax loss carryforward was totally recovered.</span></span><br/>
        <br/>
      </div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f712" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f713">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-weight: bold;">16.1 Financial risk factors</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f713" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f714">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-style: italic;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f714" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f715">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The Company&#8217;s activities and the market in which it operates expose it to a series of financial risks: market risk (including foreign exchange risk,
        interest rate risk, and commodity price risk), credit risk and liquidity risk.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f715" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f716">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f716" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f717">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The Company&#8217;s risk management framework establishes that a risk map is determined that measures the potential impact of each of them on the
        financial situation and results of operations. Based on this, the Executive Officers are responsible for defining the policies, procedures, limits and measures aimed at mitigating the impact of said risks.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f717" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f718">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f718" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f719">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The sensitivity analyzes included below are based on the change in one of the factors while all others remain constant. In practice, this is
        unlikely to happen, and changes in several factors can be correlated, for example, in variations in the interest rate and variations in the foreign currency exchange rate.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f719" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7110">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7110" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7111">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">Sensitivity analysis only provides limited vision, at one point in time. The actual impact on the Company&#8217;s financial instruments could vary
        significantly with respect to the impact shown in the sensitivity analysis.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7111" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7112">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">16.1.1 Risk associated with exchange rates</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7113" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7114">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7114" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7115">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">Exchange rate risk management</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7115" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7116">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7116" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7117">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">In view of the main impacts of the aforementioned situation and those detailed in Note 1 to these Consolidated Financial Statements, the Company has
        implemented a series of measures to mitigate their impact. In this sense, the Company&#8217;s Management permanently monitors the evolution of the situations that affect its business, in order to determine the possible actions to be taken and identify
        the eventual impacts on its equity and financial situation. The Company considers that its current financial position will allow it to comply, in the short term, with its foreign currency commitments. The Company&#8217;s financial statements should be
        read in light of these circumstances.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7117" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7118">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7118" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7119">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The Company is primarily exposed to the fluctuation of the exchange rate of the U.S. dollar against the Argentine Peso due to the fact that almost
        its entire financial indebtedness is denominated in U.S. dollars. The exposure to other currencies is not significant.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7119" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7120">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7120" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7121">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">As regards to the revenue derived from the Natural Gas Transportation segment, the tariffs charged by the Company are currently denominated in
        Argentine pesos. On the other hand, revenues in US dollars derived from the Liquids Production and Commercialization segment accounted for approximately <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:PercentageOfEntitysRevenue" id="Fact_fc1fcac39d4d4604b99c3a42a9057e34" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_CurrencyAxis_USD_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:PercentageOfEntitysRevenue" id="Fact_733aea58043b415d8c7d6a82f0439ad4" contextRef="c20220101to20221231_CurrencyAxis_USD_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:PercentageOfEntitysRevenue" id="Fact_6f6f2009f7e44693b3d80f8cb9c74e46" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_CurrencyAxis_USD_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">87</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>% of the segment&#8217;s total revenues for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022. </ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7121" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7122">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7122" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7123">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">As of December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:PercentageOfEntitysRevenue" id="Fact_93017d9228ee409fa1b6bd818bed6552" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_CurrencyAxis_ARS_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">44</ix:nonFraction>%,
        <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:PercentageOfEntitysRevenue" id="Fact_6a248fa4a7924978a92ba851a3a8e88c" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_CurrencyAxis_ARS_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">35</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:PercentageOfEntitysRevenue" id="Fact_9dc898cc5ef841f3943bf1028e6a36ff" contextRef="c20220101to20221231_CurrencyAxis_ARS_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">35</ix:nonFraction>% of total
        revenues are denominated in Argentine, respectively.</div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7123" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7124">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7124" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7125">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs&#8217;</span> financial risk management policies are defined with the objective of mitigating the impact of exchange
        rate fluctuations on the Company&#8217;s foreign currency position. To this end, alternative investment evaluations are regularly carried out to diversify <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs&#8217;</span> investment portfolio among instruments denominated in
        U.S. dollars or, although denominated in Argentine pesos, to obtain positive returns in real terms.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7125" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7126">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7126" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7127">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">Additionally, if deemed appropriate, the Company enters into derivative financial instruments that allow hedging the fluctuation of the U.S. dollar
        on the positions in such currency in the long term. </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7127" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7128">

</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">However, the Company, in order to mitigate the impact on the future variation of the exchange rate, has placed funds in assets denominated in U.S.
        dollars. As of December 31, 2024, <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfFundsDenominatedInUSDollars" id="Fact_4abc5c8c3a944bdd966e6f518505e8e3" contextRef="c20241231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">81</ix:nonFraction>% of the Company&#8217;s fund placements are denominated in U.S. dollars.</div>
</ix:continuation>

</ix:continuation>

      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">Management of the Company estimates that, based on the net asset / liability position as of December 31, 2024 and 2023, a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageAppreciationDepreciationRateOfUSDollarAgainstArgentinePeso" id="Fact_2e97d16e9d044e49aec986a328a407a1" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">10</ix:nonFraction>% appreciation in the exchange rate of the U.S. dollar against the Argentine peso, with all other economic-financial variables stable, could have
        resulted in a pre-tax income / (loss) of Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax" id="Fact_4196c2eb161c48d9a57394431b0419b6" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">10,758,875</ix:nonFraction> and (Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax" id="Fact_876a04324780485cb7c3a4e7a1ab6d1c" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" sign="-" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">13,625,470</ix:nonFraction>), respectively. A <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageAppreciationDepreciationRateOfUSDollarAgainstArgentinePeso" id="Fact_56d587ba562c4930802f6e3bc5ad1ccd" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">10</ix:nonFraction>% depreciation of the U.S. dollar against the
        Argentine peso would have an equal and opposite effect on the Statement of Comprehensive Income. This sensitivity analysis is theoretical as the actual impacts could differ significantly and vary over time.</div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7134" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7135">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">In order to mitigate the exchange rate risk, during fiscal year<span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"> 2024, </span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';"> entered into both forward purchase operations of US dollars, as well as investments in mutual
          funds linked to the US dollar</span> in order to hedge exposure to the risk associated with the exchange rate that derives from its financial debt.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7135" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7136">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7136" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7137">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">16.1.2 Interest rate risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7137" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7138">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7138" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7139">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">Interest rate risk management seeks to reduce financial costs and limit the Company&#8217;s exposure to increases in interest rates. <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8217; exposure to risks associated with interest rate variations is limited given that all of its financial debt is subject to fixed interest rates. Information regarding the Company&#8217;s financing is disclosed in
        Note 13.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7139" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7140">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7140" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7141">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">In addition, the main objective of the Company&#8217;s financial investment activities is to obtain the highest return by investing in low-risk and highly
        liquid instruments. The Company maintains a portfolio of cash equivalents and short-term investments comprised of investments in mutual funds and deposits in interest-bearing bank accounts, public and private securities. The risk of these
        instruments is low since they are mostly short-term and highly liquid in recognized financial institutions.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7141" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7142">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7142" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7143">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">As a consequence of the application of IAS 29, maintaining monetary assets generates loss of purchasing power, provided that such items are not
        subject to an adjustment mechanism that compensates to some extent the loss of purchasing power. This loss of purchasing power is included in the result of the period under gain on the net monetary position. On the contrary, maintaining monetary
        liabilities generates a gain in purchasing power, which are also included in such line item.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7143" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7144">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7144" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7145">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The Company&#8217;s risk management policies are defined with the objective of reducing the impact of the loss of purchasing power. During the 2024 and
        2023 fiscal years the Company has maintained an asset net monetary position. As a consequence, <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has recorded a net gain from exposure to inflation in the
        monetary items. In the fiscal year 2022, the Company maintained a liability net monetary position, resulting a net gain from exposure to inflation in the monetary items. </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7145" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7146">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">16.1.3 Commodity price risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7155" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7156">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7156" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7157">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">Commercial operations performed by the Company in its Liquids Production and Commercialization business segment are affected by a number of factors
        beyond its control, including changes in the international prices of the products sold, and government regulations on prices, taxes and other charges, among others.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7157" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7158">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7158" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7159">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The sales prices of exported propane, butane and natural gasoline are determined according to international reference prices (Mont Belvieu for
        propane and butane and NWE ARA for natural gasoline). Additionally, most of the total sales of propane and butane that are made in the domestic market are made at prices set by the Secretary of Energy for the different market segments.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7159" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7160">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7160" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7161">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">These prices have historically fluctuated in response to macroeconomic conditions and changes in supply and demand, which could affect <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs&#8217;</span> profitability.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7161" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7162">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7162" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7163">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">Based on volume of sales for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>estimated that, other
        factors being constant, a decrease of US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:IncreaseDecreaseInInternationalPriceOfLiquidPetroleumGasAndNaturalGasoline" id="Fact_dc5ad373137a44bfa8fc7bc8e843edfb" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CommodityPriceRiskMember" unitRef="U010" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="tgs:IncreaseDecreaseInInternationalPriceOfLiquidPetroleumGasAndNaturalGasoline" id="Fact_63b5b2f3f3ea4ff083008fac22dbed28" contextRef="c20220101to20221231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CommodityPriceRiskMember" unitRef="U010" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="tgs:IncreaseDecreaseInInternationalPriceOfLiquidPetroleumGasAndNaturalGasoline" id="Fact_5792cf09d2a94a0e9062e74ca94d9e93" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CommodityPriceRiskMember" unitRef="U010" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">50</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> per ton in the international price of LPG and natural gasoline, respectively, would
        have decrease the Company&#8217;s net comprehensive income in its Liquids Production and Commercialization segment in Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:DecreaseInNetComprehensiveIncomeDueToCommodityRisk" id="Fact_4f027cf2e4a7470fa7c0cbeb83dcbf0c" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CommodityPriceRiskMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">19,611,268</ix:nonFraction>, Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:DecreaseInNetComprehensiveIncomeDueToCommodityRisk" id="Fact_d78eaff0901548bbbb4d942d6fe8b08e" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CommodityPriceRiskMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">29,490,323</ix:nonFraction> and Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:DecreaseInNetComprehensiveIncomeDueToCommodityRisk" id="Fact_8daf9e293af1499d89b9122d472d6ca6" contextRef="c20220101to20221231_SegmentsAxis_ProductionAndCommercializationOfLiquidsMember_TypesOfRisksAxis_CommodityPriceRiskMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">21,749,155</ix:nonFraction>,
        respectively. On the other hand, an increase of US$ 50 per ton in the international price would have had the opposite effect.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7163" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7164">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%66%F-%%-->
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7164" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7165">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">16.1.4 Credit risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7165" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7166">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7166" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7167">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The Company&#8217;s exposures to credit risk takes the form of a loss that would be recognized if counterparties failed to, or were unable to, meet their
        payment obligations. These risks may arise in certain agreements in relation to amounts owed for physical product sales, the use of derivative instruments, and the investment of surplus cash balances. This risk mainly results from economic and
        financial factors or from a possible default of counterparty.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7167" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7168">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7168" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7169">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The Company is subject to credit risk arising from outstanding receivables, cash and cash equivalents and deposits with banks and financial
        institutions, and from the use of derivative financial instruments. The Company&#8217;s policy is to manage credit exposure to trading counterparties within defined trading limits.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7169" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7170">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7170" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7171">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">Trade and other receivables</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7171" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7172">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7172" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7173">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">If any of the Company&#8217;s customers are independently rated, these ratings are used. Otherwise, if there is no independent rating, the Company
        assesses the credit quality of the customer taking into account its financial position, past experience and other factors. The Company may seek cash collateral, letter of credit or parent company guarantees, as considered appropriate.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7173" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f7174">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">The credit risk on cash and cash equivalents and other financial placements is limited since <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has

        in order to limit exposure to a few financial institutions. The Company&#8217;s maximum exposure to credit risk will be given by the carrying value of assets included in cash and cash equivalents and other financial assets measured at amortized cost.</div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71107" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71108">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71108" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71109">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">16.1.5 Liquidity risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71109" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71110">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71110" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71111">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">This risk involves the difficulties that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> may have in meeting its commercial and financial obligations.
        To this end, the expected cash flow is regularly monitored.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71111" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71112">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71112" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71113">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has policies for borrowing funds whose main objective is to cover financing needs at the lowest cost
        according to market conditions. One of the Company&#8217;s main objectives is to have financial solvency. Given the current conditions of the financial market, the Company believes that the availability of resources and the positive cash flow from
        operations are sufficient to meet its current obligations, despite having credit lines for borrowing funds.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71113" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71114">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71114" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71115">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">Additionally, a methodology is used for the analysis and assignment of credit limits to the different financial entities in order to minimize the
        associated liquidity risk. In line with this, the Company invests its liquid funds in financial entities with an adequate credit rating.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71115" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71116">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

        financial debt.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">16.2.2 Fair value measurement hierarchy and estimates</div>
</ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71152" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71153">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71153" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71154">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;">According to IFRS 13, the fair value hierarchy introduces three levels of inputs based on the lowest level of input significant to the overall
            fair value. These levels are:</div>
</ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71154" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71155">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 18pt;"> <br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation>
        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71155" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71156">
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="width: 18pt;">&#160;</td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: 18pt; font-size: 8pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span></td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Level 1:</span> includes financial assets and liabilities whose fair values are estimated using quoted prices (unadjusted)
                  in active markets for identical assets and liabilities. The instruments included in this level primarily include balances in mutual funds and public or private bonds listed on the <span style="font-style: italic;">Bolsas y Mercados
                    Argentinos S.A.</span> (&#8220;BYMA&#8221;). Mutual funds mainly invest in highly liquid instruments with low price risk.</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>
</ix:continuation>
      </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71156" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71157">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71157" continuedAt="Text_7542aed3ac9f46f59ef89aa0bb455f71158">
<div>
        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="width: 18pt;">&#160;</td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: 18pt; font-size: 8pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span></td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Level 2:</span> includes financial assets and liabilities whose fair value is estimated using different assumptions quoted
                  prices included within Level 1 that are observable for the asset or liability, either directly (i.e. as prices) or indirectly (for example, derived from prices). Within this level, the Company includes those derivate financial instruments
                  for which it was not able to find an active market.</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>

        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="width: 18pt;">&#160;</td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: 18pt; font-size: 8pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span></td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">Level 3:</span> includes financial instruments for which the assumptions used in estimating fair value are not based on
                  observable market information.</div>
              </td>

    <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:DisclosureOfRegulatoryFrameworkTextBlock" id="Text_0b073bf4b4434e97a18ea0b59beae06c" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c71">

    <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; font-weight: bold;">17.</td>

    <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
            <div style="font-weight: bold;">REGULATORY FRAMEWORK</div>
          </td>

  </tr>


</table>
</ix:nonNumeric>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c71" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c72">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c72" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c73">
<div>
      <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="width: 18pt;">&#160;</td>

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 18pt;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold;">a.</div>
            </td>

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold; text-align: justify;">Regulatory framework of the Natural Gas Transportation Segment</div>
            </td>

  </tr>


</table>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c73" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c74">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c74" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c75">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 18pt;">General Aspects</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c75" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c76">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c76" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c77">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Regarding




















      <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8217; Natural Gas Transportation business, it is regulated by Law No. 24,076 (&#8220;the Natural Gas Act&#8221;), its regulatory Decree No. 1,738/92 and the Regulatory framework for the transportation and distribution of
      natural gas in Argentina. The Natural Gas Act created ENARGAS, which is entitled, among other things, to set the basis for the calculation, monitoring, approval of tariffs and the power to verify compliance with the Natural Gas Law and its
      regulations. On January 28, 2016, Resolution No. 7 of the Ministry of Energy and Mining (&#8220;MINEM&#8221;) of Argentina repealed the Resolution 2000/2005 of the former Ministry of Federal Planning, Public Investment and Services (&#8220;ex MPFIPyS&#8221;) which provided
      that all tariff increases should have the prior intervention of the Undersecretary of Coordination and Management Control.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c77" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c78">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c78" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c79">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8217; License has been granted for an original period of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfTransportationLicenseGranted" id="Fact_450dc0c926b64f11bb83d18ae83f00d8" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">35</ix:nonNumeric> years beginning on December 28, 1992. However, the Natural Gas Act provides that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>may apply to ENARGAS for a renewal of its license for an additional period of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfExtensionOnLicenseGranted" id="Fact_c2957319698e4f0595395a5746e196e7" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric>. ENARGAS should evaluate at that time the performance of <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> and raise a recommendation to the
        Executive Branch. At the end of the period of validity of the license, 35 or <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:LicensePeriodAfterRenewal" id="Fact_2845b637dbb44b4baa41be0ac75426e1" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">45</ix:nonNumeric>, as appropriate, the Natural Gas Act requires a call for
        a new tender for the granting of a new license, in which <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, provided the Company fulfilled substantially with the obligations resulting from the license, would have the option of matching the best offer
        that the Government received in this bidding process.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c79" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c710">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c710" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c711">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Although the License expires in December 2027, it can be extended by the Executive Branch for an additional period of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfExtensionOnLicenseGrantedForExpirationDate" id="Fact_bf206b2278704779a9fddd6ba3f2fa8a" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">10</ix:nonNumeric> years, provided that certain technical conditions established in it are met. Furthermore, in accordance with the regulations of the Ley Bases, the
      mentioned <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfExtensionOnLicenseGrantedForExpirationDate" id="Fact_d61b18178a264262b26230e1a307580d" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">10</ix:nonNumeric>-year period is extended to <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:AdditionalTermOfExtensionOnLicenseGrantedForExpiration" id="Fact_e23e97048aed478c9566ca94a74661df" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">20</ix:nonNumeric>
      years.<br/>
      <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c711" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c712">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">On September 8, 2023, the Company submitted to ENARGAS the request to initiate the procedure contemplated in Article 6 of the Natural Gas Law No.
      24,076 for the renewal of the License. On June 13, 2024, ENARGAS issued a technical and legal report indicating that the Company has fully complied with its obligations regarding the License. The aforementioned report allows the ENARGAS controller,
      after the non-binding public hearing held on October 21, 2024, to issue its recommendation report to be submitted to the PEN, which could ultimately issue the decree granting the required extension of the License. Following this submission of the
      ENARGAS recommendation, the PEN may issue the decree granting the extension of the License within <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:NumberOfBusinessDaysToGrantDecreeForExtensionOfTheLicense" id="Fact_0826d14be0594ff2be6d85596a060130" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durday">120</ix:nonNumeric> business days.<br/>
      <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c712" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c713">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">As of the date of issuance of these Financial Statements, the PEN decree is still pending issuance, which is estimated to be issued during the first
      half of 2025 after the various public bodies have been involved.<br/>
      <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c713" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c714">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Tariff situation</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c714" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c715">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c715" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c716">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Prior
      the enactment of the Public Emergency Law, and according to the Regulatory Framework, transportation tariffs were to be calculated in US dollars and converted into Argentine pesos at the time the customer was billed using the exchange rate prevailing
      at the date of the billing. The basic natural gas transportation tariffs charged by tgs had been established at the time of the privatization of GdE and were to be adjusted, subject to prior authorization, in the following cases: (i) <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:NaturalGasTransportationTariffsPeriodConditionOne" id="Fact_a8c463d829694c61bfea7f155e98135b" contextRef="c20240101to20241231">semi-annually</ix:nonNumeric> to reflect changes in the US producer price index (&#8220;PPI&#8221;) and (ii) every <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:NaturalGasTransportationTariffsPeriodConditionTwo" id="Fact_43bf5e1ee5db4edfb0d2935a37d88068" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">five years</ix:nonNumeric> according to efficiency and investment factors determined by ENARGAS. The &#8220;efficiency factor&#8221; was a reduction to the base tariff resulting from future efficiency
      programs while the &#8220;investment factor&#8221; increased the tariffs to compensate the licensees for future investments which were not repaid through tariffs. Also, subject to ENARGAS approval, tariffs were to be adjusted to reflect non-recurrent
      circumstances or tax changes, other than income tax.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c716" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c717">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c717" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c718">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Following the enactment of the Public Emergency Law, the adjustment clauses for tariffs based on the value of the US dollar and those based on foreign
      price indexes, as well as any other indexing mechanism, were eliminated. Additionally, the law established an exchange rate of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ConversionRateOfExchangeForTariffs" id="Fact_629514dbf600418d9025fb8a3b1faf05" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">one</ix:nonFraction>
      Argentine peso equal to <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ConversionRateOfExchangeForTariffs" id="Fact_9143c15fa64346fa9abf51669ece76ff" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">one</ix:nonFraction> US dollar for tariffs and granted the Executive Branch power to renegotiate public service contracts with the
      licensee companies according to certain criteria established therein. The law, after successive extensions, expired on December 31, 2017.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c718" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c719">
<div style="margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c719" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c720">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Between July 2003 and March 2018, the Company received a series of temporary tariff increases under the framework of the Integral Tariff Review (&#8220;RTI&#8221;
      for its acronym in Spanish) process initiated after the Public Emergency Law was passed.<br/>
      <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c720" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c721">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">After being approved by the various intervening government agencies and the National Congress, the 2017 Integral Agreement signed on March 30, 2017
      was ratified on March 27, 2018, through Decree No. 250/2018 (the &#8220;Decree 250&#8221;) of the Executive Branch. This decree represents the conclusion of the RTI process and the completion of the 2017 Transitional Agreement, and thus, the final renegotiation
      of the license after <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:NumberOfYearsForNegotiationsUnderTransitionalAgreement" id="Fact_e15277fe0990402fb40c31584d9d3f79" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">seventeen years</ix:nonNumeric> of negotiations.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c721" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c722">
<div style="margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c722" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c723">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">The 2017 Integral Agreement sets the guidelines for the provision of the natural gas transportation service until the end of the License. Among these
      guidelines:</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c723" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c724">
<div style="margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c724" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c725">
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr>

    <td style="width: 36pt;"><br/>
          </td>

    <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; text-align: justify;">&#8226;</td>

    <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
            <div style="text-align: justify;">The RTI Process, which will culminate in the signing of the integral agreement, was approved. As a result of this RTI, a new tariff schedule was also approved. This new tariff schedule applicable to the Company
              determined a total tariff increase of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariffOnServiceForNaturalGasTransportation" id="Fact_bcfdab3914d6407fbcc04c7212db9c19" contextRef="c20170330" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">214.2</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariffOnAccessAndUse" id="Fact_ea38eb8bfb8042bca16b78630560c318" contextRef="c20170330" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">37</ix:nonFraction>%, in the event that it had been granted in a single installment as of April 1, 2017, on the tariff of the natural gas transportation service and the CAU, respectively.</div>
          </td>

  </tr>
