<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Semi-annual tariff increase</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c733" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c734">
<div style="margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c734" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c735">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">As mentioned above, following the completion of the RTI process, the Company is granted the right to receive a semi-annual tariff adjustment, which is
      subject to the authorization of ENARGAS.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c735" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c736">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c736" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c737">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">In the public hearing held on September 4, 2018, in which the Company requested, based on the variation of the WPI recorded for the period February -
      August 2018, a tariff increase of approximately <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariff" id="Fact_fe0fcdbde9984b5988458c20cabbc9f1" contextRef="c20180904" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">30</ix:nonFraction>%. Considering the hearing, on September 27, 2018, ENARGAS issued Resolution No.
      265/2018 which determined a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariff" id="Fact_aaf75786d75e4348947f319d62b719cb" contextRef="c20181002" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">19.7</ix:nonFraction>% tariff increase effective as of October 1, 2018.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c737" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c738">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c738" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c739">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">This increase was determined by ENARGAS based on the simple average of the WPI, the Construction Cost Index for the period February and August 2018
      and the Salary Variation Index between December 2017 and June 2018.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c739" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c740">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c740" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c741">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">On March 29, 2019, ENARGAS issued Resolution No. 192/2019 (&#8220;Resolution 192&#8221;) that approved, effective as of April 1, 2019, a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariffOnServiceForNaturalGasTransportation" id="Fact_6f0051d2fb2f4afbb5fb8ab87a36c688" contextRef="c20190401" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">26</ix:nonFraction>% increase in the tariff chart applicable to the public service of natural gas transportation by <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> in force as of March 31, 2019.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c741" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c742">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c742" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c743">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">In accordance with current regulations, ENARGAS has considered the evolution of the wholesale price index update index (&#8220;WPI&#8221;) between the months of
      August 2018 and February 2019, in order to define the semi-annual adjustments applicable to <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> tariffs.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c743" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c744">

    </div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Regarding the semi-annual tariff adjustment that was to be enforced as from October 1, 2019, on September 3, 2019, the SE issued Resolution No.
      521/2019 (&#8220;Resolution 521&#8221;) postponing it to February 1, 2020, subsequently modified by Resolution No. 751/2019 by which it was postponed until February 1, 2020. This deferral also meant that the Company has adapted, in equal proportion to the income
      that is not received, the execution of the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Fact_bfccfa2458a749ad9978fa7d198c979b">Five-Year</span> Investment Plan.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>

    </div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Following the enactment of the Solidarity Law, the national government announced its intention to suspend tariff adjustments for public services for
      the transportation and distribution of natural gas and electricity under federal jurisdiction for 180 days, in order to initiate a process of renegotiation of the RTI, or to initiate an extraordinary tariff review. On June 18, 2020, the PEN
      promulgated Decree of Necessity and Urgency No. 543/20, through which the tariff freeze established by the Solidarity Law was extended for another 180 calendar days.<br/>
      <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c747" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c748">

        framework of the Solidarity Law was determined</span>.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c748" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c749">

Until then, the current renegotiation agreements were suspended. Said renegotiation remained in the power of ENARGAS ad-referendum of the PEN. The
      renegotiation process was extended on successive occasions, the last of which was until July 9, 2025. </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Additionally, the Solidarity Law provides for the administrative intervention of ENARGAS, recently extended through Decree 1,023/2024 (&#8220;Decree
      1,023&#8221;).</div>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c757" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c758">
<div style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Additionally,




















      in such public hearing, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> denied and dismissed the arguments raised in it that considered that the current natural gas transportation tariff is not fair and reasonable given the alleged existence of serious
      defects in the administrative acts derived from the processing of the last Regime Comprehensive Tariff (&#8220;RTI&#8221;) made for <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>.</div>

<div style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">On
      December 14, 2023, ENARGAS Resolution No. 704/2023 called for a public hearing to be held on January 8, 2024 in order to consider a temporary tariff adjustment.<span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><br/>
      </span><br/>
      On December 16, 2023, decree No. 55/2023 was issued declaring the emergency of the national energy sector until December 31, 2024 which was extended until July 9, 2025 by Decree 1023 of November 19, 2024. Among other issues, this decree: (i)
      establishes the beginning of the process of Five-year Tariff Review (&#8220;RQT&#8221;), (ii) the intervention of ENARGAS as of January 1, 2024 and (iii) instructs the Ministry of Energy to issue the necessary standards and procedures for the sanction of market
      prices for the public transport service of natural gas. Decree 1023 provides that the entry into force of the tariff tables resulting from the tariff review initiated pursuant to the provisions of Decree No. 55/23 may not exceed July 9, 2025.</div>
</ix:continuation>

      After the public hearing was held on January 8, 2024 and its validity was declared by ENARGAS, On March 26, 2024, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> entered the 2024&#8217;s Transitional Agreement with the ENARGAS, which provides for a
      transitional <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfTransitionalAdjustmentInNaturalGasTransportationTariffs" id="Fact_12c46c70c8cf4b9d83e4205ba6ecc30d" contextRef="c20240326" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">675</ix:nonFraction>% increase in natural gas transportation tariffs. This tariff increase came into effect on April 3, 2024, after Resolution
      No. 112/2024 (the &#8220;Resolution 112&#8221;) issued by ENARGAS was published in the Official Gazette. According to Resolution 112, as from May 2024 and until the RTI process is completed, tariffs are adjusted monthly according to the following formula (the
      &#8220;Transitional Adjustment Index&#8221;):<br/>
      <br/>
      - <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfWageIndex" id="Fact_b84dc3999d574cf59f355360f1bc032b" contextRef="c20240403" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">47.0</ix:nonFraction>% adjusted by the Wage Index - Registered Private Sector published by INDEC<br/>
      - <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfDomesticWholesalePriceIndex" id="Fact_ec56a9df0e86426881a086d512aa04be" contextRef="c20240403" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">27.2</ix:nonFraction>% adjusted by the WPI<br/>
      - <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfConstructionCostIndex" id="Fact_10a6bab960ba4441ab51fd9ca923b6ff" contextRef="c20240403" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">25.8</ix:nonFraction>% adjusted by the Construction Cost Index in Greater Buenos Aires - Materials chapter published by INDEC.<br/>
      <br/>

      this end, ENARGAS will issue the corresponding monthly resolution adjusting the tariff tables to be applied. On May 9, 2024, ENARGAS notified the licensee companies of the public natural gas transportation and distribution service of the postponement
      of the monthly tariff adjustment mentioned above. </div>

      It is worth noting that the operation of gas pipelines by <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> requires a high level of investment related to the quality, safety and reliability of the service. This is the reason why it is important to
      determine the tariff for the public service of natural gas transportation based on a prudent and efficient economic operation, which allows obtaining sufficient income for the provision of a sustainable, safe and reliable service.<br/>
      <br/>
      In this regard, and within the framework of the RQT process, on January 14, 2025, ENARGAS, through Resolution No. 16/2025, published the call for the public hearing held on February 6, 2025, with the purpose of considering, among other issues, the
      RQT for gas transportation and distribution, and the periodic adjustment methodology for gas transportation and distribution tariffs.<br/>

      alternatives for the periodic tariff adjustment methodology were presented:</div>

                  rate of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:WeightedAverageCostOfCapitalAfterTax" id="Fact_9ed7bccfcaa94aec8db9bf49adfbd056" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="4" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">7.18</ix:nonFraction>% real, after taxes, and a periodic tariff adjustment proposal composed of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfConsumerPriceIndex" id="Fact_9cdd8a633e99480c9fceb607be5190ec" contextRef="c20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">50</ix:nonFraction>% CPI and <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfWholesalePriceIndex" id="Fact_2a78569d59c648b6923b7a39575958d9" contextRef="c20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">50</ix:nonFraction>% WPI.</span><br/>
              </div>

</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7149" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7150">

    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7150" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7151">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">The Liquids Production and Commercialization and Midstream segments are not subject to regulation by ENARGAS, and as it is provided in the Transfer
      Agreement, is organized as a separate business unit within <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, keeping accounting information separately. However, over recent years, the Argentine Government enacted regulations which significantly impacted
      on it.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7151" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7152">

    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7152" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7153">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">In April 2005, the Argentine Government enacted Law No. 26,020 which sets forth the regulatory framework for the industry and commercialization of
      LPG. Among other things, the Law No. 26,020 creates the framework through which the Secretary of Hydrocarbon Resources (&#8220;SHR&#8221;) (formerly the Federal Energy Bureau) establishes regulations meant to cause LPG suppliers to guarantee sufficient supply of
      LPG in the domestic market at low prices. Law No. 26,020 creates a price regime pursuant to which the SRH periodically publish reference prices for LPG sold in the domestic market. It also sets forth LPG volumes to be sold in the domestic market.</div>
</ix:continuation>

      No. 49/2015 issued by the Federal Energy Bureau, which created the Programa Hogares con Garrafa (the &#8220;Households with Bottles Program&#8221;) which replaced the programs in force until that time. The Households with Bottles Program was implemented through
      Resolutions No. 49/2015 and No. 470/2015 issued by the Federal Energy Bureau.</div>

      commercialization chain in order to guarantee the supply to low-income residential users, forcing producers to supply with LPG at a certain price and at a certain quantity defined for each of them. Initially, the payment of compensation to the
      participating producers of the Households with Bottles Program was established, which was eliminated as of February 2019.</div>

      maximum sale price set for products provided under the Home Program (with the export parity price published by the SE under Law No. 26,020 being the sale price limit). Additionally, although this resolution maintains the obligation for LPG producers

      Secretariat.</div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Presidential Decree No. 488/2020 regulated the applicable tax rate on exports of certain oil and gas products, including those products that we export, establishing a range between <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ApplicableTaxRateOnExportOfOilAndGasProducts" id="Fact_69a145446efd4416b8ac53b5900dfe97" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_RangeAxis_BottomOfRangeMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ApplicableTaxRateOnExportOfOilAndGasProducts" id="Fact_d2e8e9ae8c9248d1921fb6bf66a8da8a" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_RangeAxis_TopOfRangeMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">8</ix:nonFraction>% depending on the &#8220;ICE Brent
        first line&#8221; barrel price. If the price is below US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionOne" id="Fact_d3180c82ebc24606b4f5a712a94f3494" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U012" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">45</ix:nonFraction>, the tax rate will be <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfApplicableTaxRateOnBarrelPriceConditionOne" id="Fact_0404724948d846cf8e41a08cc4179279" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">zero </ix:nonFraction>percent. On the other hand, if the price is equal to or higher than US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionTwo" id="Fact_48fca34b3a034cca9f49af4d96187820" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U012" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">60</ix:nonFraction>, an
        <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfApplicableTaxRateOnBarrelPriceConditionTwo" id="Fact_1032112091db4c43855bf6e800753556" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">8</ix:nonFraction>% tax rate will be paid, being variable if the price is between US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionOne" id="Fact_5388074076b043e497140b79c4a4db84" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U012" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">45</ix:nonFraction> and US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionTwo" id="Fact_663c209817ab4dffaa18594c930a3e43" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U012" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">60</ix:nonFraction>.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7177" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7178">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7178" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7179">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">During 2023, the Company participated, within the framework of Resolution No. 808/2023 of the Ministry of Energy, of the Export Increase Program created by Decree 576/22.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7179" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7180">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7180" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7181">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">According to said program, the Company must enter <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInForeignCurrency" id="Fact_a60ec224a0614f9a913c5a0713db1c50" contextRef="c20231003to20231003" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">75</ix:nonFraction>%
      of the value of its exports in foreign currency into the country. The remaining <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInPesos" id="Fact_a3b85c4a76cd433dacc6bf6f1fe408df" contextRef="c20231003to20231003" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">25</ix:nonFraction>% may be settled in pesos through the purchase of
      negotiable securities. To qualify for the scheme, exports must be settled between October 2 and October 20, 2023, and the effective export date must not be later than November 30, 2023.</div>
</ix:continuation>

    </div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Subsequently, said program was extended by Decree No. 28/2023, which also modifies the settlement ratio, which is currently <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInForeignCurrency" id="Fact_9509ea179df24ab18249443471c52fd7" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">80</ix:nonFraction>% through the MULC and the remaining <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInPesos" id="Fact_3622cc62a46a40e9b31178c314e67831" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">20</ix:nonFraction>%
      through sales and purchase operations of negotiable securities. </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div><span style="font-weight: bold;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7185" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7186">
<div style="font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Decree No. 2,067 / 08 (the &#8220;Decree&#8221;)<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7186" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7187">
<div style="font-style: italic; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7187" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7188">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">Through Presidential Decree No. 2,067/08, the Executive Branch created a tariff charge to be paid by: (i) the users of regulated services of
      transportation and / or distribution, (ii) natural gas consumers receiving natural gas directly from producers without making use of transportation systems or natural gas distribution, (iii) the natural gas processing companies in order to finance
      the import of natural gas. The tariff charge sets forth in this decree finance the higher price of the natural gas imports required to compensate the injection of natural gas necessary to meet national requirements (the &#8220;Charge&#8221;). When the Charge was
      created, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> paid it in accordance with the provisions of Resolution I-563/2008, at Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:TariffChargePaidPerCubicMeter" id="Fact_61231318d031407daf3e37667c29e6d5" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U013" decimals="4" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0.0492</ix:nonFraction>/m3.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7188" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7189">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7189" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7190">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt;">The payment of the natural gas processing tariff charge was selectively subsidized from 2008 according to the destination of the natural gas. In
      November 2011, however, ENARGAS issued Resolution No. 1,982/11 and 1,991/11 (the &#8220;Subsidy Beneficiaries Resolutions&#8221;) which modified the list of the subsidy beneficiaries, and thus, involved a cost increase for many of our clients and for us (for
      certain of our consumption for our own account). The natural gas processing tariff charge increased from Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:TariffChargePerCubicMeter" id="Fact_62924f2da95c44999cb4ffb38754c388" contextRef="c20111130to20111130" unitRef="U013" decimals="4" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0.0492</ix:nonFraction> to Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:TariffChargePerCubicMeter" id="Fact_b16e3c9d08cf4ece8d609e4a8d7dfc5c" contextRef="c20111201to20111201" unitRef="U013" decimals="3" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0.405</ix:nonFraction> per cubic meter of natural gas effective from December 1, 2011, representing a significant increase in our variable costs of natural gas processing.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7190" continuedAt="Text_f83dd530ece34f5fa7832d9bca94d8c7191">

    </div>

      National Government, ENARGAS and ex MPFIPyS as defendants.</div>

      Gazette of the Argentine Republic, by means of which the regulation of the so-called Dedicated Branches for the Large Investment Incentive Regime (&#8220;RIGI&#8221;) provided for in Law No. 27,742, under the terms of its article 170, is established. This regime

This project aims to expand the Perito Moreno Gas Pipeline (formerly the N&#233;stor Kirchner Gas Pipeline) through the construction of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:NumberOfCompressorPlant" id="Fact_794c4b278ea345cdabb68e17b3713bbe" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U014" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">3</ix:nonFraction> new compressor plants and the upgrading of the Tratay&#233;n and Saliquel&#243; compressor plants.<br/>

      presented by tgs will be governed by the contracting system provided in Article 6 of Decree No. 76 of February 11, 2022, which stipulates that ENARSA, with the approval of the Ministry of Economy, may enter into freely negotiated contracts related to
      transportation capacity with producers and/or shippers for the construction or expansion, in whole or in part, of the Perito Moreno Pipeline. On February 25, 2025, the Ministry of Economy issued Resolution No. 169/2025, delegating to the Secretariat
      of Energy and ENARSA the responsibility for conducting the bidding process for the Private Initiative. This resolution also establishes a series of guidelines that ENARSA must consider when drafting the tender documents. As of the date of issuance of
      these Consolidated Financial Statements, the bidding process prompted by the Private Initiative for the award of the new transportation capacity resulting from the expansion project has not yet been launched.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>

      equals <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfLegalReserveOnSumOfCapitalStockAndAdjustmentToCapitalStockBalances" id="Fact_7ff7b731f16245e183d3a344d58bb6b5" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">20</ix:nonFraction>% of the sum of (i) &#8220;common stock nominal value&#8221; plus (ii) &#8220;inflation adjustment to common stock,&#8221; as shown in our consolidated

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">After the issuance of the Resolutions, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> filed a judicial action before the National Court of First Instance in Federal
      Administrative Litigation No. 1 (the &#8220;Court&#8221;) in order to obtain the declaration of nullity of the Presidential Decree No. 2067/08 and the Resolutions as well as the unconstitutionality of the administrative acts that created the Charge.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe5" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe6">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe6" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe7">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On July 5, 2012, the Court issued in favor of <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> a precautionary measure by which the suspension of the Charge was ordered in
      the terms set forth in the Resolutions. This decision was appealed in different opportunities by the National Government, by virtue of which the dictating of the precautionary measure was limited to the validity of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:ValidityPeriodOfPrecautionaryMeasure" id="Fact_3f69f7daf2cb4c01bca1825cd6ac6959" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">six months</ix:nonNumeric>. However, at maturity, the Company was entitled to obtain a new precautionary measure for a similar period.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe7" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe8">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe8" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe9">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As a result, on September 19, 2017, a new extension of the injunction was obtained (which prevented the Government to claim <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>
      of the payment of the amounts resulting from the new value of the Charge for the period between the November 2011 and March 2016), thus extending the validity until March 2018 or until the issuance of the judgment that resolves the substance of the
      matter, whichever occurs first.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe9" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe10">

    </div>
</ix:continuation>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe10" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe11">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On the other hand, the National Court of Appeals in Contentious Administrative Dismissal rejected the extraordinary appeal filed by the National Government against the
      judgment of that court that confirmed the rejection made by the Court at the request of ENARGAS to declare abstract the legal action initiated by tgs in accordance with the precedent &#8220;Alliance&#8221; issued by the Supreme Court in December 2014.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe11" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe12">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe12" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe13">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On March 26, 2019, TGS was notified of the judgment of first instance issued by the Federal Contentious-Administrative Court No. 1 in its claim initiated by which <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> requested the unconstitutionality of Decree No. 2,067/08; Resolutions and of any other rule or act issued or to be issued, that is caused by the mentioned rules (the &#8220;Cause&#8221;).</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe13" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe14">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe14" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe15">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The first instance judgment declares the unconstitutionality of both Articles 53 and 54 of Law 26,784, as well as the aforementioned rules and of any other act tending
      to execute said provision, and consequently, the nullity of said rules (the &#8220;sentence&#8221;).</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe15" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe16">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe16" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe17">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Judgment was appealed by the National Government on March 29, 2019, and the appeal was granted on April 3, 2019, which has not been resolved as of the closing date
      of the year.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe17" continuedAt="Text_c4647e6ec5984af4aeb5eb5676160bfe18">

    </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On October 29, 2019, the intervening judge decided, considering what was decided in the judgment and attending to the reasons invoked by <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, to extend the validity of the precautionary measure issued for <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Fact_94f39f1cba65431db8199f14a360a899">six</span> more months of processing in said ordinary process
      and / or until the sentence passed is firm.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Pursuant to the isolation measures adopted by the Argentine Government under the COVID development, the judicial deadlines were suspended from March 20, 2020 until July
      21, 2020.<br/>

          surrounding areas, causing widespread flooding across urban and adjacent regions<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> (the &#8220;Event&#8221;). </span></div>

          and partially affected natural gas transportation services. It is also worth noting that the external electric distribution system, as well as the electric generation and distribution facilities of the installation, were impacted<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">.</span></div>
